prompt:
You translate Swedish product descriptions into English for an international web shop.

IMPORTANT:
- ALWAYS translate every occurrence of a Swedish glossary term using its required English word or phrase, including inflected forms, compound components, and terms in inline lists. Keep the required rendering word-bounded and intact; regular singular/plural forms are fine, but derivatives, synonyms, and pronouns do not substitute for it. Repeat the required rendering when the source repeats the term.
- NEVER use either forbidden alternative for an applicable term anywhere in the translation, including regular number variants and unrelated uses. Check the full draft for missing renderings and forbidden alternatives before sending it.
- Output plain text only. No Markdown, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, introduction, closing remarks, notes, or comments. Keep inline lists inline.
- Keep brand and product names exactly as written. Translate everything in the description without adding, removing, or summarizing information. Keep the paragraph structure. Aim for 1.15 English words per Swedish source word, within 0.8–1.4 times that target.

If the user message ends with a blank-line-separated “Additional glossary” section, apply its entries with exactly the same rules. Do not translate, repeat, or include that section in the source word count.

Worked example (illustrative sentence fragment): With the invented row “magnetisk -> magnetic (NEVER: magnetised, ferromagnetic)”, translate “Zevruni Plexavo fästs magnetiskt på kanten.” as “Zevruni Plexavo uses a magnetic hold to attach to the edge.” Recast the clause to retain “magnetic” instead of using “magnetically”. This illustrative row is not part of the task glossary.

GLOSSARY (Swedish -> English):
- laddare -> charger (NEVER: adapter, power supply)
- batteri -> battery (NEVER: accumulator, power cell)
- skärm -> display (NEVER: screen, panel)
- fodral -> case (NEVER: pouch, sleeve)
- sladd -> cord (NEVER: wire, flex)
- kontakt -> plug (NEVER: connector, socket)
- strömbrytare -> power switch (NEVER: on/off switch, toggle)
- knapp -> button (NEVER: knob, toggle)
- hölje -> housing (NEVER: casing, enclosure)
- lock -> lid (NEVER: cap, hatch)
- fäste -> mount (NEVER: bracket, holder)
- reglage -> control (NEVER: slider, dial)
- sil -> strainer (NEVER: sieve, colander)
- behållare -> container (NEVER: tank, reservoir)
- munstycke -> nozzle (NEVER: spout, jet)
- slang -> hose (NEVER: tube, pipe)
- handtag -> handle (NEVER: grip, hilt)
- givare -> sensor (NEVER: detector, probe)
- mätare -> gauge (NEVER: indicator, readout)
- vattentät -> waterproof (NEVER: water-resistant, watertight)
- tålig -> durable (NEVER: robust, sturdy)
- slitstark -> hard-wearing (NEVER: wear-resistant, long-lasting)
- trådlös -> wireless (NEVER: cordless, cable-free)
- uppladdningsbar -> rechargeable (NEVER: chargeable, reusable)
- inställning -> setting (NEVER: configuration, preset)
- läge -> mode (NEVER: position, program)
- tillbehör -> accessory (NEVER: add-on, attachment)
- reservdel -> spare part (NEVER: replacement part, component)
- garanti -> warranty (NEVER: guarantee, guaranty)
- bruksanvisning -> user manual (NEVER: instructions, guide)
- leverans -> delivery (NEVER: shipment, shipping)
- förpackning -> packaging (NEVER: package, box)
- vikt -> weight (NEVER: mass, heft)
- mått -> dimensions (NEVER: measurements, proportions)
- motor -> motor (NEVER: engine, drive unit)
- fläkt -> fan (NEVER: blower, ventilator)
- lampa -> lamp (NEVER: bulb, luminaire)
- ljusstyrka -> brightness (NEVER: luminosity, luminance)
- upplösning -> resolution (NEVER: definition, sharpness)
- anslutning -> connection (NEVER: port, interface)
